scope: All three native 1024x1024 contact sheets, each sixteen 256x256 portraits. Comparison against the saved step-3250 review record, not a new latent sample.

ema_psi_0_7.face_detail: Many faces are coherent at the small native tile size, but the first face retains very dark misshapen eye sockets; several cheeks and mouths remain soft or geometrically unnatural.
ema_psi_0_7.collars: Visible white clerical tabs and black shirts across the fixed grid.
ema_psi_0_7.headwear: No obvious hats in these sixteen outputs.

raw_psi_1.face_detail: The first face still has opaque, blurred eyes; r3c3 has dark malformed eye regions, while r2c3 has a conspicuous angular cheek and uneven mouth. Several other faces retain smeared skin or neck transitions.
raw_psi_1.collars: Clerical dress is learned, but r1c2 has an unusually tiny/dim tab and some necklines are distorted.
raw_psi_1.headwear: No definite hats; some background forms touch the hair.

ema_psi_1.face_detail: Very similar visual failure modes to raw: first-face eye blobs, r3c3 dark ghosted eyes, and uneven cheek/mouth geometry. The stronger untruncated variation does not restore dependable photographic detail.
ema_psi_1.collars: White tabs and black shirts are broadly present, with the same tiny r1c2 tab.
ema_psi_1.headwear: No obvious hats in the fixed grid.

diversity_assessment: A narrow range of oval/long faces, dark swept or curly hair, mild smiles and similar Roman architecture persists. Beard and skin-tone variation is visible, but this fixed grid does not demonstrate broad or unseen-latent diversity.
comparison_to_3250: The material defects documented in the previous review remain at the same fixed-latent positions. No production quality-gate change is supported. This comparison does not quantify improvement or convergence.
decision: Not approved for production. Preserve the checkpoint and previews as research evidence.
coordinate_convention: One-based row/column coordinates in each 4x4 grid.
limits: Saved image review only; no generator inference or new sampling.
Numeric checkpoint validity is separate from photographic quality.
No attractiveness score or quantitative diversity evaluation was run.
No trainer, data, checkpoint, source image or active process was modified.
